regression_matrix.validate_release.sh: exit 0 — 22 local checks evidenced; 5 external blockers recorded

deferred_canonical_ingestion.evidence: check_memory_write_bypass.py rule 'deferred-canonical-ingestion' passes; verified against a negative control that fires. Only migration/legacy_write_queue.py may read a serialized MemoryWriteRequest, and it has no enqueue path.

competing_canonical_write_authority.evidence: commit_write remains restricted to services/memory_service.py. Lifecycle transitions are now governed by a new 'direct-lifecycle-transition' rule allowlisting memory_service.py, maintenance/service.py, and the three store adapters that implement the operation; verified against a negative control.

content_derived_admission_identity.evidence: MemoryService._operation_identity mints operation:{namespace}:{uuid4} when no explicit key is supplied; the duplicate lookup runs only for an explicit key. normalized_digest persists purely as a maintenance candidate signal.

runner_local_store_as_distributed_author.evidence: store_backend selects sqlite or postgres with no silent fallback; a DSN-less postgres selection is rejected at configuration and construction. The nightly workflow references no database file and CI now runs the shared-backend matrix against a real PostgreSQL service. Remediated further by ADR-077: build_store fails closed when the configured store is empty while a prior local ledger still holds records, naming the ledger and its count, with an explicit L9_MEMORY_ACKNOWLEDGE_BACKEND_TRANSITION escape hatch.

unrecoverable_outbox_processing.evidence: Claims are time-bounded leases; expired leases are reclaimable and a stale settle is rejected. Proven on all three backends plus an eight-thread contention test on PostgreSQL.

projection_retirement_conflated_with_era.evidence: ProjectionAdapter.retire is distinct from erase; supersession and archive emit retirement intent in the same transaction as the canonical transition. Archive preserves content, evidence, and state and produces no deletion receipt. Remediated further by ADR-076: adapters declare a retirement_mode, every retirement writes a ProjectionRetirementReceipt to canonical state (validated to never assert erasure), and MemoryService.rebuild_projection re-projects withdrawn records so withdrawal is reversible.

blanket_administrator_scheduler_credenti.evidence: AuthorizationAction.MAINTAIN with per-namespace grants. Maintenance succeeds with MAINTAIN and no WRITE grant, and is refused without MAINTAIN. The nightly workflow sets no write, promote, or administrator namespaces.

maintenance_as_ingestion_surface.evidence: MaintenanceRequest forbids unknown fields and its declared field set is pinned by test, so adding an ingestion-capable field fails CI.

known_limitations_stated_not_hidden: Graphiti exposes no native deactivation primitive, so GraphitiProjection.retire calls the same delete_episode tool as erase. ADR-076 declares the ceiling as RetirementMode.WITHDRAW, records every retirement in canonical state so the distinction does not depend on the provider log, and adds rebuild-projection so withdrawal is reversible. The shared provider call remains a provider ceiling, not a defect.

GitHub cron is UTC-only, so 02:00 America/New_York is achieved by firing at both candidate UTC instants and gating. Verified as a property across all 365 days of 2026 including both DST transitions. Residual: a firing delayed more than 59 minutes by GitHub is skipped; maintenance is idempotent and watermarked, so the next run absorbs the backlog, but the skip is currently silent. Not remediated in this PR.

Cross-backend data migration remains deliberately out of scope and unauthorized (ADR-072). ADR-077 guards the operational trap that boundary left open: a local-ledger-to-shared-backend transition now fails closed instead of serving a healthy empty store. Transitions between two remote backends are still undetectable without credentials and are documented as requiring manual verification.
